args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring already documented banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py
to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`. The `round_money` docstring already stated that banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) is used per FIN-212, but the implementation was passing `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `Decimal.quantize`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

**Root cause:** `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) in its docstring, but the actual `quantize` call used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `test_half_even` failed on `Decimal("2.665")` (expected `2.66`, got `2.67`).

**Fix:**
- Created branch `fix/money-round-half-even` from main.
- Changed `round_money` to import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit `08d3cd5986`).
- CI run `ci-0001` passed.
- The PR open was initially rejected because main had moved ahead, so I merged latest main into the branch (`0a9452f727`), confirmed the fix was intact, and re-ran CI (`ci-0002`) — passed.

**Pull request:** [#101 — Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101), open against `main` with review requested from **alex**.

I did not merge the PR, since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
